title: 真实请求镜像边界：只复制获批合成GET，写操作与敏感请求仍只到主上游
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    fixed=copy.deepcopy(base)
    manager=fixed['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']
    routes=manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']
    approved=copy.deepcopy(routes[0]);approved['name']='approved-synthetic-mirror'
    headers=[{'name':':method','string_match':{'exact':'GET'}},{'name':':path','string_match':{'exact':'/mirror-probe'}},{'name':'content-length','string_match':{'safe_regex':{'regex':'(?:0)?'}},'treat_missing_header_as_empty':True}]
    for name in ('authorization','cookie','transfer-encoding'):headers.append({'name':name,'present_match':False})
    approved['match']={'path':'/mirror-probe','headers':headers}
    approved['route']['request_mirror_policies']=[{'cluster':'shadow','runtime_fraction':{'default_value':{'numerator':100,'denominator':'HUNDRED'}}}]
    routes.insert(0,approved)
    return fixed
```

原题知识说明：
镜像请求可能携带真实用户数据并触发测试端副作用，且镜像结果通常不直接决定主响应。明确允许方法、脱敏、目标隔离和负载预算，验证镜像比例与关闭机制；不能默认测试环境可以接收所有生产流量。

实现configure(base)深拷贝，在首个HCM/virtual host现有route前增加approved-synthetic-mirror。仅GET且:path精确/mirror-probe（无query）、无Authorization/Cookie/Transfer-Encoding、Content-Length缺失或0时，以100% request_mirror_policies复制到已存在shadow cluster；其他请求原样走原primary route且不镜像。主请求结果不受shadow返回500影响，主上游每次仅收到一次；POST/PUT、带授权/ Cookie/ query/正文以及其他路径均不得到shadow。保留原routes、clusters和主请求身份数据。题定请求由获批HTTP/1.1合成探针产生，不把这些头条件视作任意不可信HTTP/2正文的完整脱敏方案。

## 提交产物

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13及两个私有HTTP上游，实际异步镜像和主/影子请求记录；只用固定测试数据。不连接业务镜像服务，不证明任意真实流量的敏感数据清洗或业务副作用安全。

sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Upstream() as primary,Upstream(status=500) as shadow:
 base=bootstrap(primary.port);cluster=base['static_resources']['clusters'][0];cluster['name']='primary';cluster['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='primary'
 mirror=copy.deepcopy(cluster);mirror['name']='shadow';mirror['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='shadow';mirror['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'][0]['endpoint']['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=shadow.port
 base['static_resources']['clusters'].append(mirror);hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['route']['cluster']='primary'
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 with Envoy(fixed) as proxy:
  assert proxy.request('/mirror-probe',headers={'x-probe-id':'approved-first'})[0]==200
  cases=[('/mirror-probe','POST',b'write-data',{}),('/mirror-probe','PUT',b'write-data',{}),('/mirror-probe','GET',None,{'Authorization':'fixture-only'}),('/mirror-probe','GET',None,{'Cookie':'fixture-only'}),('/mirror-probe?private=value','GET',None,{}),('/mirror-probe','GET',b'private-body',{}),('/ordinary','GET',None,{})]
  for index,(path,method,body,headers) in enumerate(cases):
   assert proxy.request(path,method,body,{**headers,'x-probe-id':'forbidden-'+str(index)})[0]==200,'primary operation changed'
  assert proxy.request('/mirror-probe',headers={'x-probe-id':'approved-last'})[0]==200
  deadline=time.monotonic()+2
  def ids():return {next((v for k,v in row['headers'].items() if k.lower()=='x-probe-id'),None) for row in shadow.requests}
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and 'approved-last' not in ids():time.sleep(.01)
  time.sleep(.08)
  assert ids()=={'approved-first','approved-last'} and len(shadow.requests)==2,[(r['method'],r['path']) for r in shadow.requests]
  assert len(primary.requests)==len(cases)+2,'mirroring replaced or duplicated primary work'
 restored=copy.deepcopy(fixed);added=hcm(restored)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'].pop(0)
 assert added['route']['request_mirror_policies'][0]['cluster']=='shadow' and restored==base,'existing route or primary cluster changed'

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实ring hash会话粘性：同头键稳定、URI变化和端点顺序不改分配
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    fixed=copy.deepcopy(base)
    clusters=[c for c in fixed['static_resources']['clusters'] if c.get('name')=='service']
    if len(clusters)!=1:raise ValueError('one service cluster required')
    clusters[0]['lb_policy']='RING_HASH';clusters[0]['ring_hash_lb_config']={'minimum_ring_size':1024,'maximum_ring_size':1024}
    manager=fixed['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']
    manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['route']['hash_policy']=[{'header':{'header_name':'x-session-key'},'terminal':True}]
    return fixed
```

原题知识说明：
先固定请求哈希来源，再测端点增删时键迁移比例、负载偏斜和热点键。核对实现参数、端点权重和跨实例配置一致性；均匀分配不保证热键均衡，客户端无稳定哈希输入也不会得到可复现亲和性。会话状态仍需要独立容灾设计。

import sys,pathlib,copy,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Upstream() as a,Upstream() as b,Upstream() as c:
 peers=[a,b,c];base=bootstrap(a.port);entries=[]
 for peer in peers:entries.append({'endpoint':{'address':{'socket_address':{'address':'127.0.0.1','port_value':peer.port}}}})
 base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints']=entries
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 keys=['session-'+str(i) for i in range(96)]
 def gather(proxy,prefix,repeats):
  offsets=[len(p.requests) for p in peers]
  for key in keys:
   for _ in range(repeats):assert proxy.request('/'+prefix+'/'+key,headers={'x-session-key':key})[0]==200
  mapping={}
  for identity,peer in enumerate(peers):
   for row in peer.requests[offsets[identity]:]:
    key=next(v for k,v in row['headers'].items() if k.lower()=='x-session-key')
    mapping.setdefault(key,set()).add(identity)
  assert set(mapping)==set(keys) and all(len(hosts)==1 for hosts in mapping.values()),'same session moved between hosts'
  assert set.union(*mapping.values())=={0,1,2},'finite sample did not exercise every host'
  return {k:next(iter(v)) for k,v in mapping.items()}
 with Envoy(fixed) as first:mapping=gather(first,'first',3)
 reordered=copy.deepcopy(fixed);reordered['static_resources']['clusters'][0]['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'].reverse()
 with Envoy(reordered) as second:
  again=gather(second,'second',1);assert again==mapping,'endpoint list order or URL path changed header-key affinity'
 restored=copy.deepcopy(fixed);target=restored['static_resources']['clusters'][0];target['lb_policy']='ROUND_ROBIN';target.pop('ring_hash_lb_config')
 hcm(restored)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['route'].pop('hash_policy')
 assert restored==base,'endpoints, metadata, request budgets or other routing fields changed'
 for clusters in [[],[copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['clusters'][0])]*2]:
  invalid=copy.deepcopy(base);invalid['static_resources']['clusters']=clusters
  try:task.configure(invalid)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('missing or duplicated service cluster accepted')

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
